text: Brindlewood Industrial relies on 200 third-party partners to repair its equipment under warranty.
Every claim comes in by phone or email, into one shared inbox Natalie Fairweather's team sorts by hand.
Claims get lost, partners can't check status, and partners' own field-service software can't reach Brindlewood at all.
Natalie Fairweather, Director of Partner Operations, sponsors this project -- she wants partners self-served and her team out of the inbox.
Next: turning 'partners need self-service' into one precise, testable requirement before any configuration happens.
